item: The launcher-record helper waits for a deferred writer's row; test_page_reading patches os.fstat only as page_reading sees it
summary: R336: _assert_all_present in tests/test_launcher_records_race.py polls up to DEFERRED_ROW_WAIT_S (30 s, the docstring names what it protects) for rows a launcher handed to its deferred writer (R174, written after the launcher exits), then makes the same three assertions; a row that never arrives fails naming the rows and the wait. Red first: a row appended 0.4 s after the look failed the one-look helper. scripts/launch.sh is untouched; the PowerShell variant was not run. R344 (shipped in #1588 first): the stat-failure test in tests/test_page_reading.py replaced os.fstat on the os module for the whole process; it now patches a namespace copy of os read only by page_reading, and requires the real os.fstat to work inside the window (red on the process-wide patch). The cause is pytest 9.2.0 (R350): its capture snap() calls os.fstat at the end of the call phase while the process-wide patch is live; MEASURED: the old form fails under 9.2.0 and passes under 9.1.1, the scoped form passes 47/47 under 9.2.0; no pytest pin. A foreign thread's os.fstat in the window does not fail the test (measured, caught and uncaught, also under the Core-only block plugin); the process-wide class is removed by construction. R339 sweep: no other test that patches is_encrypted_file also boots the app through the lock gate, so none can poison the 5 s header cache the way #1588's test did (test_poll_storm, test_backup_snapshot, test_export_pauses_collection, test_open_stats, test_passphrase_unencodable, test_sweep4_passphrase_arguments checked by reading).
